# Production Reference Library

## Browser Automation Engineering — Five-Volume Reference Set

This collection accompanies the *Browser Automation Playbook — Production Engineering Edition* (Version 2.0.0).

|----------|-------------|
| Architecture Field Guide | Decision matrices, reference architectures, scaling roadmap |

| War Stories | 20 production incidents with root cause analysis |
